# Lasm

> Lasm compiles Lean 4.35.0 programs ahead of time to WebAssembly for Node servers, serverless functions (AWS Lambda, Vercel, Netlify, Azure, Google Cloud Functions), edge functions (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, Netlify Edge, Deno Deploy, Supabase), Bun, Deno, Fastly Compute, WASI/wasi-http/Spin and browsers. It ships on npm as `@lasm/cli` (bin `lasm`, current version 0.6.1) and installs Lean and all build tools itself; the only prerequisite is Node 24+ (or Bun/Deno). Lean code calls JavaScript and npm through `import Lasm.JS` with one `@[js "module" "export"]` declaration per function. Proofs and tactics run at build time; a deployed program cannot elaborate or evaluate new Lean.

Key commands:

- New project: `npm create @lasm@latest my-app -- --template <plain|express|hono|fastify|std-http|web|fetch|fullstack> [--deploy <target>]…`
- Develop: `npm run dev` (= `lasm dev`: rebuild about 2 s after each save, restart, keep the last good build on errors)
- Run a file: `npx @lasm/cli Main.lean [-- args]`; build: `npx @lasm/cli build Main.lean [--target <target>] [--output DIR]`
- Targets: node (default), lambda, lambda-edge, vercel, netlify, azure, gcf, workers, vercel-edge, netlify-edge, deno-deploy, supabase-edge, bun, deno, wasi, wasi-http, fastly, browser
- Editor support for `import Lasm.*`: `npx lasm editor`; version for bug reports: `npx lasm --version`

## Getting started

- [README](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/README.md): quick facts, the start-here table, recipes per target, measured numbers, limits
- [Getting started](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md): a Hono server with Lean handlers, an npm package, a container, a function platform, editor setup
- [Agent guide](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/AI.md): rules and pitfalls for AI agents writing Lasm code
- [How Lasm works](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/HOW_LASM_WORKS.md): the pipeline from Lean to C to WebAssembly, the host bridge, the targets, the cache, the libraries
- [The edit loop](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/DEVELOPER_WORKFLOW.md): `lasm dev`, build errors, several outputs at once
- [All documentation](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/README.md): every document in reading order

## CLI

- [CLI reference](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/README.md#cli-reference): every command, option and environment variable
- [Templates](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/tree/main/templates): what `npm create @lasm` and `lasm init --template` create (plain, express, hono, fastify, std-http, web, fetch, fullstack)
- [Tool cache and requirements](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/NODE_SUPPORT.md): where Lasm keeps Lean and its tools, and how to recover
- [Installation hardening](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION_HARDENING.md): retries, offline repair, proxies and private CAs
- [System Git](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/MANAGED_GIT.md): Git for Lake dependencies

## Libraries

- [Lasm.JS](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/JS_BINDINGS.md): `@[js]` declarations, type conversions, `Async`, callbacks, errors, a checklist for agents
- [Lasm.Fetch](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/FETCH.md): one `Request → Async Response` handler for every server target, outbound `fetch`, streaming
- [Lasm.UI](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/UI.md): browser apps (Elm architecture, `html!`, commands, subscriptions, routing, SSR, hydration, what is proved)
- [Lasm.RPC and Lasm.KV](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/RPC.md): typed endpoints shared by server and browser, validation proved once; a key-value store over each platform's own
- [Lasm.Web](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/BROWSER.md): typed DOM and web-platform bindings, the browser loader and mount API, the Vite plugin
- [Library sources](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/tree/main/library/Lasm): the Lean code of every library, including Lasm.Fastly (Fastly's stores)

## Platforms

- [Where apps run](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md): every platform and how CI tests it
- [Supported platforms](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/README.md#supported-platforms) and [build machines](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/README.md#supported-environments): the table with evidence levels; operating systems, architectures, Node/Bun/Deno versions
- [Deploy recipes](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/deploy/README.md): Docker/Kubernetes, Lambda, Lambda@Edge, Vercel, Netlify, Azure, Google Cloud, Fly.io, Railway, Render, Heroku, DigitalOcean
- [Edge functions](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/EDGE.md): Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, Netlify Edge, Deno Deploy, Supabase; the single-threaded profile and its limits
- [Bun and Deno](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/BUN_DENO.md): the compiler and your programs on Bun or Deno
- [WASI, wasi-http and Fastly Compute](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/WASI.md): standard WebAssembly with no JavaScript (wasmtime, wasmer, Spin, Fastly)
- [Browser](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/BROWSER.md): `--target browser`, static hosting ([deploy guide](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/deploy/browser.md))

## Examples

- [examples/conduit](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/tree/main/examples/conduit) (flagship): the RealWorld "Conduit" app entirely in Lean. It has a REST API, a server-rendered Lasm.UI frontend (hydration, Markdown in Lean) and 52 proved propositions (307 theorems) about the running code ([PROOFS.md](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/examples/conduit/PROOFS.md): authorization, follows, favorites, slugs, pagination, shared validation, JSON round trips, Markdown link safety; no `sorry`). It runs on Node (`node:sqlite`), Cloudflare Workers (D1) and Bun (`bun:sqlite`) through one `@[js]` binding module each, and the official RealWorld API and Playwright suites pass. Run: `cd examples/conduit && npm install && npm run build && npm start`; `npm run proofs`; `npm test`; `npm run test:e2e`
- [examples/README.md](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/examples/README.md): every example with its one-command run
- [tandem](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/tree/main/examples/tandem) (flagship): a collaborative editor on a sequence CRDT, the same Lean in the browser and the sync server, with proved convergence
- [folio](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/tree/main/examples/folio): a CommonMark renderer and static-site generator with proofs that Markdown cannot inject HTML
- [porter](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/tree/main/examples/porter) and [ledger](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/tree/main/examples/ledger) (in progress): an OpenID Connect provider and a double-entry ledger, proofs first
- [hello](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/tree/main/examples/hello), [js-fetch](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/tree/main/examples/js-fetch) (a `@[js]` binding), [js-crud](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/tree/main/examples/js-crud) (Express/Hono + Postgres + JWT), [fetch](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/tree/main/examples/fetch) (pure Lean HTTP everywhere), [edge-pure](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/tree/main/examples/edge-pure), [wasi-cli](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/tree/main/examples/wasi-cli), [ui](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/tree/main/examples/ui) (counter, TodoMVC with proofs)
- [templates/fullstack](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/tree/main/templates/fullstack): server + browser + verified API (what `--template fullstack` creates)

## Testing and evidence

- [How Lasm is tested](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/TESTING.md): differential testing against native Lean, target equivalence, scenario matrix, host-bridge model and schedule fuzzing, mutation testing, evidence levels
- [Language coverage](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/LANGUAGE_COVERAGE.md): per-platform results for the language and standard library
- [Compatible Lean packages](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): Lake packages tested with Lasm
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md): cold start, size, memory, throughput, interop cost, build times with CI runs
- [Evidence records](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/tree/main/docs/evidence): recorded test results

## Limitations

- [Known limitations](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/README.md#known-limitations): what each target cannot do (single-threaded targets have no sockets or processes; files only on Node and WASI)
- [Lean support and restrictions](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/README.md#lean-support-and-restrictions): exactly what a deployed program cannot do (ahead-of-time only)
- [Licenses](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/LICENSING.md): licensing of apps you build; the notices are written on every build ([license audit](https://github.com/Millillion/lasm/blob/main/docs/LICENSE_AUDIT.md))
